claims: The Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team has made four Final Four appearances in the NCAA Tournament in 1988, 1994, 1997, and 2001.
All four Final Four appearances by the Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team occurred under head coach Lute Olson.
In 1988, the Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team lost in the Final Four semifinals to Oklahoma.
In 1994, the Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team lost in the Final Four semifinals to Arkansas.
In 1997, the Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team defeated Kentucky to win the National Championship.
In 2001, the Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team defeated Michigan State in the Final Four semifinals.
In 2001, the Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team lost to Duke in the championship game.
The Arizona Wildcats men's basketball program has not returned to the Final Four since 2001.
